messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=inference-runtime severity=critical trigger=latency.p99>2000ms over 5m — alert: https://alerts.redwood/INC-1801239876

mira: acked — I'm on it. starting quick triage, checking p95/p99 dashboards now.

ops-bot: autoscaler: current_replicas=12 desired=18 (scale up in progress)

sam: seeing tail in eu-west-1. p99 jump ~2.3s, p95 ~650ms. KV cache evictions spiked at the same time.

mira: running a couple of queries: `sum(rate(inference_latency_p99[5m]))` -> trend shows sustained p99 spike for 7m.

jen: any recent deploys to runtime? I see one canary 22m ago but no full rollout.

sam: no deploys in last hour. traffic pattern: big fanout from a customer background job — many long-context requests.

mira: mitigating plan: 1) enable emergency autoscale (ops-bot triggered) 2) route heavy requests to dedicated pool 3) enable kv-cache warmup for hot keys.

ops-bot: emergency_autoscale: triggered by mira at 1801240005. target_replicas=30. ETA for new nodes ~3m.

ryan: preparing traffic shift: will add routing rule to send requests >600 tokens to dedicated-reserved-1. Doing a dry-run first.

mira: dry-run logs: `curl -X POST https://router.redwood/route -d '{"match": {"tokens_gt": 600}, "target":"dedicated-reserved-1","dry":true}'` -> matches ~4% of traffic (~QPS 12).

sam: hotkey list: user:acct-5520 showing repeated long sessions. evicting their KV entries temporarily to reduce eviction churn.

jen: suppressing noisy follower alerts: incidentbot suppression window 10m to avoid dup pages.

mira: after autoscale nodes come up p99 dropped from 2300ms -> 1200ms, p95 steady. still above SLO target but improving. continuing.

ops-bot: new_replicas_healthy=18 at 1801240302; new_replicas_healthy=30 at 1801240600.

sam: after routing shift p99 now ~700ms in us-west, eu-west still ~950ms. KV warmup reduces tail errors.

mira: customer impact check: running query on client-facing error rate and latency by org -> orgs 4/120 reported degraded experience, most are internal test traffic. No major customer-facing degrade found yet.

ryan: temporary throttle policy applied to anonymous bulk jobs: `max_concurrent=3` for requests >1200 tokens. Implemented.

sam: observing queue backlog reduce after throttle and routing. p99 steady ~600-800ms across regions.

mira: prepping post-incident actions: capture sample prompts that triggered large contexts, add a guardrail to block runaway fanout jobs, add metric for kv-eviction-rate per shard.

jen: will open ticket INF-4567 with action items, include rollout of per-org request size limits.

mira: I'm going offline in 20m. handing to sam for monitoring and follow-up. brief: autoscale remains on, routing rule active, suppression window until next update.

sam: ack — will monitor next 2 hours and escalate if p99 creeps back. leaving a note in the incident doc.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved (auto) — incident cleared at 1801243200 — resolution: routing + autoscale + throttle mitigations applied.

mira: closing thread, please add any follow-up notes to INF-4567. :white_check_mark:
